scope: all current and future material Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse chats, agents, workflows, scenarios, incidents, recoveries, development runs and production verifications
purpose: Bind every material Powerhouse run to verified canonical state and authority before material execution, so memory/context alone can never be mistaken for active governance.

must_ask_user_only_for: new or increased paid external resources
genuinely new product or architecture choice not derivable from canonical authority or safe defaults
must_not_ask_again_for: already approved canonical writeback and documentation
safe implementation details derivable from existing standards
continuation of an already authorized material run

approval_request_rule: Before asking the user for approval, the runtime must resolve whether the decision is already covered by canonical authority. If covered, asking is blocked and the agent must continue autonomously. If a hard human-authority boundary exists, the runtime returns ASK_USER with the exact boundary reason.
refresh_receipt_when: hard boundary is resolved or introduced
